name: Institutions of Higher Education in Hesse: Doctoral Scholarships
summary: Specific higher education institutions of the state of Hesse award doctoral scholarships to particularly qualified junior scholars and researchers who wish to conduct doctoral research at a Hessian higher education institution. Applications
